rationale: Z has the most specific, original hero (an annotated lighthouse survey drawing), plus rich concrete data throughout, including timeline bars, dated testimonials with stats and a carefully set serif and italic type pairing. Y is a polished dark cozy design with a nicely tilted puzzle card, but its sections follow the standard SaaS card grid. X is clean and competent, but its light cream blocks, uniform card grids and the hero's puzzle card overlapping the scene (which looks awkward on mobile) make it the most template-like.
